title: Terminal baseline verifier hashes checkout line endings

source_observation.environment: Windows exact C32 full no-reuse calibration on dev fa3481be with Factorio 2.1.13
source_observation.fact: The static.full terminal baseline verifier compared tracked canonical UTF-8/LF manifest identities to physical CRLF checkout bytes and rejected unchanged Git content.

reproducer.expected: Tracked baseline JSON and generator identities compare as canonical UTF-8/LF material on both LF and CRLF checkouts while frozen ZIPs retain exact physical-byte verification.
reproducer.observed: declared/compatibility-claims.json had the expected canonical SHA-256 C18E7CA16F9DA6B16A44FDA9184776633218D8FF40684D7B5FF42A25A2A77666 but physical CRLF checkout SHA-256 BCA5D0EA5EFB3C7FA2449793C6519AC7C11BAA0062E67D1C398960B70B1D4711.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; package-excluded baseline verifier and generator identity only
regression_obligations: CRLF tracked baselines pass canonical manifest binding
LF and CRLF baseline regeneration and matrix identities are equal
frozen release ZIP identity remains an exact physical-byte hash
fixed_point_restart_scope: all target baseline and assurance proofs produced after this correction; no package shadow restart

admission.reason: The failure is reproduced, bounded to package-excluded text identity, and correctable without changing product source or frozen package bytes.
